title: ageratina gracilenta
intro: Ageratina gracilenta, commonly known as yerba de la tormenta, is a plant species in the mint family (Lamiaceae) native to Mexico and Central America. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its reported health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ageratina gracilenta include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate pain, and support the immune system, which is attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of Ageratina gracilenta, but its traditional use suggests potential benefits for various health conditions.
